title: An owner sets the organization's monthly model spend ceiling
description:
Today the model spend ceiling is a deployment default (USD 25.00 per org per UTC month, CHATTICUS_MONTHLY_MODEL_SPEND_CEILING_USD). Let an owner change it per organization. Needs an organization read in the model gateway, a PATCH route for the ceiling, and a web form in the workspace.

Feature: Owner-settable model spend ceiling
  Scenario: An owner raises the ceiling
    Given an organization whose month spend is at the default ceiling
    When the owner sets a higher monthly model spend ceiling
    Then the next model call is allowed
  Scenario: A member cannot set the ceiling
    When a non-owner member sends the PATCH
    Then the request is refused
right_now_summary: The team is adding owner controls for each organization's monthly model spend ceiling.
